description: A warm, inviting transitional kitchen with a clear European farmhouse character. The ceiling is defined by a handsome grid of dark-stained solid wood beams forming a coffered pattern, providing rich earthy contrast against the white plaster between them. An arched opening with a black steel-framed window on the left leads through to a living or sitting room where a stone fireplace with a rustic wood mantel is partially visible, deepening the space. The kitchen cabinetry is all white painted Shaker-profile, floor to ceiling, with a custom painted hood in matching white over a professional gas range with stainless steel appliances. The backsplash is classic white subway tile in a traditional brick pattern. The island counter is a thick slab of white marble with dramatic grey and gold veining, atop a cabinet base that has a lower accent band in warm medium-toned oak wood, creating a two-tone contrast. Island styling includes a wooden cutting board with artisan bread loaves, a small potted herb plant, a wicker basket, and on the far end a tall grey rustic ceramic vase with an olive branch arrangement. Brass hardware accents the white cabinetry and hood. Two black velvet-upholstered barstools pull up to the island. Warm glowing light falls in two soft pools over the island marble surface from overhead sources above. Camera is at standing eye-level, three-quarter view from slightly left of center, capturing the full island, cabinetry wall, and coffered ceiling.
